name: componentGroups
label: Component groups
description: An array of all component groupings

name: disabled
label: Disabled
description: If the pane should be disabled

name: error
label: Error
description: If the pane should show that there is an error

name: bindings
label: Available bindings
description: An array of all available bindings in the macroponent

name: eventHandlerElementMap
label: Event handler element map
description: A map of all available event handlers by element

name: instanceNameEditorEnabled
label: Element name editor enabled
description: If the pane should let the element name/id be edited

name: componentDefinitions
label: Component definitions
description: An array of all component definitions

name: allExtensionPoints
label: All extension points
description: An array of all available extension points

name: ancestorMacroponentData
label: Ancestor macroponent data
description: An array of all the data from the ancestor macroponent

name: extendsMacroponent
label: Extends macroponent
description: The macroponent that the current one extends from

name: controllerDefinitions
label: Controller definitions
description: An object containing all controller definitions by controller sysId

name: userScope
label: User scope
description: The name of the current scope the user is in

name: scriptCompletions
label: Script completions
description: An object containing all valid script completions for the element

name: visibilityConfig
label: Visibility config
description: An object containing options for controlling visiblity

name: macroponent
label: Macroponent
description: The macroponent currently being worked on

name: clientScripts
label: Client scripts
description: An array of client scripts associated to the current macroponent

name: clientScriptApi
label: Client script API
description: The API object available to scripted properties within this element

name: supportingElementProps
label: Supporting element properties
description: Helper object from a builder for things like selected tabs and viewports

name: subroutes
label: Subroutes
description: Array of subroutes tied to the current macroponent

name: selectedCompositionElement
label: Selected composition element
description: The element object from the composition that is currently selected

name: selectedComponentDefinition
label: Selected component definition
description: The component definition from the element that is currently selected

name: resolvedContext
label: Resolved context
description: Resolved values for items in the MCP

name: componentPresetDefinitions
label: Component preset definitions
description: Object containing all preset definitions by component id

name: controllerPresetDefinitions
label: Controller preset definitions
description: Object containing all controller preset definitions by controller id

name: selectedCompositionElementPreset
label: Selected composition element preset
description: The preset currently in use by the selected element

name: embeddedMacroponentDefinitions
label: Embedded macroponent definitions
description: Macroponent records (not tooblox components) that are contained within the composition of the macroponent

name: hiddenTestValues
label: Hide component test values
description: Object containing the test values for Component visibility for all elements in the composition

name: theme
label: Theme
description: Object containing the theme information

name: themeProperties
label: Theme properties
description: Object containing the theme properties

name: themeColors
label: Theme colors
description: Object containing the theme colors

name: dataBrokerData
label: Data broker data
description: Object containing the resolved values from all of the data brokers in the macroponent

name: dataDrivenTabsMetadata
label: Data driven tabs metadata
description: Object containing the resolved values for a data driven tab

name: elementAndDataResourceNameMaps
label: Element and data resource name maps
description: Object containing the in-use elementIds for all elements and data resources in the macroponent

name: tabsConfigurationModalOpened
label: Tabs configuration modal opened
description: True if we need to immediately open the tabs configuration modal

name: conditionalConfigurationModalOpened
label: Conditional configuration modal opened
description: True if we need to immediately open the conditional renderer configuration modal

name: classicViewportsEnabled
label: Classic viewports enabled
description: True if we want to support converting viewports from page collection mode to legacy mode

name: shareAncestorDataBrokerAndEnablePresets
label: Share ancestor data broker and enable presets
description: True if we want to support binding to ancestor data resources (e.g. for a page collection)

name: formFactor
label: Form factor
description: The selected breakpoint for responsive design layout

name: draggedValue
label: Dragged value
description: The UxValue being dragged by a user

name: builderMode
label: Builder Mode
description: Determines context of the current builder, like Page, Component, Controller, Preset, etc.

name: builderAssistantAlert
label: Builder Assistant Alert
description: Provides context around a builder assistant alert that has been activated

name: searchFacets
label: Search Facets
description: Provides context around a search facets

name: macroponentsToExcludeFromToolbox
label: Macroponent to exclude from toolbox
description: MCPs to exclude from toolbox

name: uiGenConfig
label: UI Gen Config
description: Object of UI Generation config options
